company.name: AutoStream
company.tagline: Automated Video Editing Tools for Content Creators
company.description: AutoStream is a SaaS platform that helps content creators automate their video editing workflow using AI. Whether you're a YouTuber, Instagram creator, or TikTok star, AutoStream saves you hours of editing time every week.

policies.refund_policy: No refunds are provided after 7 days from the date of purchase. Within the first 7 days, customers may request a full refund by contacting support.
policies.support_policy: 24/7 support is available exclusively on the Pro plan. Basic plan users receive email support with a response time of up to 48 hours.
policies.cancellation_policy: Users can cancel their subscription at any time. Access remains active until the end of the current billing period.
policies.data_policy: All uploaded videos are processed securely and deleted from our servers within 30 days unless saved to your library.

faq.question: What platforms does AutoStream support for publishing?
faq.answer: AutoStream allows direct publishing to YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Twitter/X. You can also export to any platform via MP4 download.

faq.question: Can I upgrade from Basic to Pro?
faq.answer: Yes, you can upgrade from Basic to Pro at any time. You'll be charged the prorated difference for the remaining billing period.

faq.question: Does AutoStream support team accounts?
faq.answer: Team collaboration is available on the Pro plan, supporting up to 3 team members. Enterprise plans with larger team sizes are available on request.

faq.question: Is there a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes, AutoStream offers a 7-day free trial on the Pro plan. No credit card is required to start your trial.

faq.question: What video formats are supported?
faq.answer: AutoStream supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM input formats. All exports are available in MP4.
